semantics.identity: publisher/source/tenant/native URL retaining query parameters; modified or admitted source version is separate
semantics.geography: Source catalog five-digit coverage prefixes are not AGS. Requested scope AGS never assigns records. Explicit source/tenant/body bindings require original structured evidence retained as supportingEvidence role municipality_join; primary evidence binds only the exact admitted source snapshot. District and Amt bodies can remain AGS=null. All nine towns are amtsfrei; Amt examples supplement, not replace them.
semantics.dates: Meeting start/end, paper date, source creation/modification, and explicitly labeled HTML Beschlussdatum are separate. OParl cancelled=true or meetingState=cancelled makes start/end cancelled_meeting_schedule; contradictory held state cannot override cancellation. Only explicit meetingState=held supplies meeting event role; other OParl and unlabeled HTML meetings retain scheduled_meeting role. No created/modified/retrieved date stands in for adoption. Beschlussdatum does not assert adopted/completed/paid.
semantics.withdrawal: Only native deleted=true emits withdrawn; missing records on partial pages are not deletion.
semantics.htmlLocators: Zero-based global a[href] and tr indices; raw text/href values before trimming. td-or-th[1] is the second immediate table cell, preserving header semantics.
semantics.resolution: resolutionText/resolutionFile and labeled resolution date/reference are attributed metadata only; no competent authority, case attachment or finalization inferred from agenda/paper labels.
semantics.meetingState: Original OParl cancelled boolean and meetingState string emit meeting_cancelled/meeting_state, including false flags and unknown/contradictory states. Embedded AgendaItem records carry parent_meeting_cancelled/parent_meeting_state using exact parent field locators. An agenda link does not prove a held meeting or decision.
semantics.decisionResult: Only original OParl AgendaItem.result strings and explicitly labeled ALLRIS/SessionNet Paper/AgendaItem Beschluss/Ergebnis cells emit decision_result. Values and exact raw field locators remain unnormalized and qualified; no legal-stage ladder, adoption or in-force inference. Missing/blank fields remain unchecked; meeting dates, vote totals, title and author account never manufacture a result.
semantics.proposer: Explicit Fraktion, Antragsteller (Fraktion), and Antragsteller (Organisation) labels emit proposing_faction/proposing_organization. Plain Antragsteller is retained only when its value expressly says Fraktion or has a native organization/body link; ambiguous personal names stay excluded. OParl Paper.originatorOrganization emits administrative_origin_organization only, not actual proposer/faction/authority. originatorPerson is ignored. No organization identity merge or membership relationship is inferred.
semantics.people: Person objects/lists are rejected; people/member/contact links and fields are not discovered or parsed.
semantics.coverage: Bounded snapshot coverage remains partial for nonempty snapshots; native empty envelopes are empty, not not-applicable. No archive-complete claim.

fixtureProvenance: Hand-authored, bounded native OParl and public ALLRIS/SessionNet HTML forms; not claims of fetched source distributions.
